profile.headline: Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer at Gigantic Playground
profile.summary: Passionate about software planning and development, I am a professional who knows how to follow instructions, work in teams, and lead coworkers when needed. Throughout my work experience, I have worked as a developer on software projects for government agencies, health insurance companies, the Colombian banking sector, and the amusement park industry, developing systems for destinations in Dubai and the US.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Developed full-stack features and maintained a serverless amusement park management platform (mobile / backend).
- Increased customer engagement by implementing gamification features for a waterpark slide attraction.
- Streamlined development and testing workflows by creating a custom Chrome extension to
simulate barcode scanner inputs without physical hardware.
- Led the integration of the Adyen payment gateway to enable contactless, tokenized NFC wristband
payments for a waterpark in Dubai.
- Built a complete full-stack e-commerce platform for a waterpark utilizing Vue 3 and NestJS.
Migrated legacy on-premise Java and Scala applications to the cloud using Azure Kubernetes Service
(AKS) for an insurance company.
positions.insights: Skills: Flutter · Vue.js · Node.js · NestJS · Java · Software Infrastructure · Software Design

positions.title: Java Developer
positions.description:
Engineered new features and maintained the retail banking web portal for a top-tier Colombian bank
using Java 8 and Java EE.
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Java EE · JavaServer Faces (JSF)

positions.title: Programmer
positions.description:
- Automated business processes for an oil and gas company using Robotic Process Automation (RPA).
- Maintained and optimized a document management platform using Java 8.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
- Developed custom ERP software for a municipal water and sanitation company.
- Boosted team productivity by engineering a Bash script that significantly reduced the time spent
synchronizing team project repositories with git.
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Spring Framework · Oracle Database
